Build clean now, exit 0.

Real error: `src/core/settings.js:17` used undefined var `retries` instead of `env.retries` → `maxRetries` came back `undefined`, threw `EBUILD01`. Fixed: `maxRetries: env.retries`.

Rest was noise: 900 lines compile log, dedupe spam, 3 harmless warnings (deprecated API, unused export, circular import) — none broke build.
